category.name: Swing Drives
category.intro: Swing drive assemblies for crawler and wheeled excavators — the complete unit that carries the swing motor. Sourcing support matched against the OEM number, the machine serial and the tag on the existing unit.

pages.title: Swing Drive for Caterpillar 313D — Sourcing & RFQ

copy.intro: The Caterpillar 313D is a 13-tonne class excavator used for utility work, trenching and residential construction. Its swing drive turns the upper structure on the swing ring — when the swing gearbox wears or the swing motor fails, the machine swings slowly, judders on start-up or loses holding power on a slope. A replacement swing drive assembly is usually the fastest route back to work.
copy.sourcing: We source the swing drive against the reference numbers below from vetted China aftermarket and OEM-equivalent manufacturers, then confirm the exact unit against the tag on your machine before you commit. Every order gets a technical check on ratio, flange and motor interface — not a blind cross-reference.
copy.fit_check: Send the OEM number stamped on the existing unit, the machine serial number and a clear nameplate photo. We check mounting bolt pattern, gear ratio, output flange and motor interface before quoting, so the unit that ships is the one that bolts on.
copy.pn_note: The numbers below are commonly associated with the Caterpillar 313D and help you cross-check the tag on your unit. Match them against your nameplate — or just send us a photo and we will identify the exact part before quoting.
copy.generation_note: Different build years and regions of the Caterpillar 313D can use different swing drive units even within the same model name. Always confirm by serial number and nameplate rather than model name alone.
copy.application: utility work, trenching and residential construction

Its swing drive turns the upper structure on the swing ring — when the swing gearbox wears or the swing motor fails, the machine swings slowly, judders on start-up or loses holding power on a slope. A replacement swing drive assembly is usually the fastest route back to work.
